note: Orchestrator shortlist after viewing contact-256.png and contact-16.png (16px is the deciding check). Subagent critiques are per-card; these are the ones worth a second roll.

shortlist.why: Cleanest die-cut M, ultra-wide letterform; the best 16px read of the set. Critic docked it for typographic edges, but that is what the brief asked for.
Oversized M hole with a thick noodle rim; second-best at 16px.
Inverted: ink noodles on bubblegum, pink M. Highest 16px contrast in the set and a fresh brand read.
Inverted on sky. Same contrast win as 21; critic flagged a faint keyline inside the M, check the source.
Exactly three fat strands. Simplest mass, M still reads at 16.
Full-bleed app-icon treatment, no badge. Reads at 16, works as an iOS/Android icon as-is.
Marker wreath on pale ground. Only card the critic passed on all four; softest of the shortlist at 16.
Open-bottom M biting out of the circle. Distinctive silhouette, decent at 16.
Udon-thick strands. Chunky and friendly, M noisy but present at 16.
Two noodle mounds forming the M. Closest to the current brain-M feel with a real hole.
